title: Canonical completed direct-image reduction transpose
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], schemes $V,W$, a morphism $f:V\to W$, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$ and let $R_T=\varprojlim_m(A_m)_T$ on the original small pro-etale site of $T=V,W$, with its actual projection $\pi_{T,n}:R_T\to(A_n)_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $D_{T,n}=L\pi_{T,n}^*$ for derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] and $U_{T,n}$ for exact derived scalar restriction [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction], with the scalar adjunction $D_{T,n}\dashv U_{T,n}$ and unit $\eta_{T,n}$ [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. Let $I_R$ be the ordinary unbounded derived direct image of actual $R_V$-module sheaves to $R_W$-module sheaves, and $I_n$ the analogous finite-coefficient derived image, using the canonical coefficient maps [def-weil-derived-direct-image] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $\rho:I_R U_{V,n}\xrightarrow\sim U_{W,n}I_n$ be the canonical derived restriction/direct-image comparison of that construction, induced by identity on sections. Define
$$\delta_{f,n}:D_{W,n}I_R\longrightarrow I_nD_{V,n}$$
to be the transpose under $D_{W,n}\dashv U_{W,n}$ of
$$I_R\xrightarrow{I_R\eta_{V,n}}I_RU_{V,n}D_{V,n}\xrightarrow{\rho D_{V,n}}U_{W,n}I_nD_{V,n}.$$
This specifies the natural transformation, with the canonical associators and unitors; no invertibility or closed-immersion hypothesis is part of the definition.

def directReduction {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) (n : ℕ) :
    sfCompletedDerivedDirectImage l E f ⋙ reduce l E W n ⟶
      reduce l E V n ⋙ proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
